patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — PrestaShop and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose PrestaShop only if your buying job matches “Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 1” rather than Wix's shape. Choose Wix only if your buying job matches “Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 (sell onlin” rather than PrestaShop's shape. Workflow advantage: PrestaShop leans shared coverage; Wix leans checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — PrestaShop and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: PrestaShop is Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 14-day trial; Enterprise quote. WooCommerce keeps t; Wix is Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 (sell online), Business $39, Business Elite $159 (annual tile.
- Company-size focus: PrestaShop (small-business, mid-market) vs Wix (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: PrestaShop-leaning — vs Wix-leaning checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: PrestaShop — Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; Wix — Website-builder commerce depth trails Shopify-class platforms on complex catalogs and B2B.

Limitations — PrestaShop: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; POS / omnichannel is module-dependent, not a native retail bundle; Wix: Website-builder commerce depth trails Shopify-class platforms on complex catalogs and B2B; Plan gates for selling start at Core — Free/Light are not store plans.

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
